environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy has a condition key lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM. The AuthType property on the function URL configuration is set to AWS_IAM which causes the Lambda service to evaluate IAM policies and signature verification on every request before invoking the function. Callers must sign requests with SigV4 using credentials from an IAM principal that has lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission with a matching resource ARN. The IAM policy attached to authorized device principals includes a StringEquals condition on aws:PrincipalOrgID restricting to the organization ou-abc1-devicepool. Unsigned requests or requests signed with credentials lacking the permission receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda Function URL invoke endpoint before the function code executes. Note: the code itself performs no authentication check — all auth is handled at the Function URL invocation layer.
